pins.name: 5V
pins.notes: 256 LEDs: up to about 15 A at full white. Use a separate 5 V supply and limit brightness

pins.name: DIN
pins.notes: Data in. Add a 330 Ω resistor; a 3.3 V to 5 V level shifter makes it reliable
